title: Stable Unsupervised Continual Chunking with Sheaf SyncMap
abstract: arXiv:2609.25143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unsupervised Continual chunking is a fundamental problem in machine learning and neuroscience, where the goal is to identify groups of states that frequently co-occur in temporal sequences. A key challenge is to form accurate chunks while maintaining their stability over time. In this work, we propose sheaf regularization to reduce local inconsistencies in Decentralized SyncMap, a self-organizing system, and thereby stabilize its chunking dynamics. We introduce a radial sheaf structure that penalizes distance-dependent radial motion between pairs of variables. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the highest normalized mutual information (NMI) among the evaluated SyncMap variants on 12 of 18 probabilistic Continual General Chunking Problem (CGCP) graphs with two-state memory and on 17 of 18 graphs with dynamic memory. translated_title: 基于层Sheaf SyncMap的稳定无监督持续分块
translated_abstract: 无监督持续分块是机器学习和神经科学中的一个基本问题，其目标是在时间序列中识别频繁共同出现的状态群组。一个关键挑战是在形成准确分块的同时保持其随时间的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们提出层正则化方法来减少Decentralized SyncMap这一自组织系统中的局部不一致性，从而稳定其分块动态。我们引入了一种径向层结构，对变量对之间依赖距离的径向运动进行惩罚。实验结果表明，在18个具有双状态记忆的概率持续广义分块（CGCP）图中的12个上，以及在18个具有动态记忆的图中的17个上，所提出的方法在所评估的SyncMap变体中取得了最高的归一化互信息（NMI）。在序列适应实验中，Sheaf SyncMap在发生变化后仍然取得了较高的NMI。
tldr: 提出一种径向层正则化结构来稳定自组织系统Decentralized SyncMap的分块动态，使其在大多数概率持续广义分块图上取得了所有SyncMap变体中最高的归一化互信息。
en_tdlr: We propose a radial sheaf regularization structure that stabilizes the chunking dynamics of the self-organizing Decentralized SyncMap, achieving the highest NMI among SyncMap variants on most probabilistic Continual General Chunking Problem graphs.
